units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:9:2">Y. Keth. IX, end, 33ᶜ</cite> <he>כהן דמר אבד כַּרְטֵיסוֹ וכ׳</he> (not <he>סן …</he>) in accordance with the opinion of him who says, if one’s document (of indebtedness) is lost, write a duplicate for him.
Ib. לבד מן כרטוסה קדמייא וכ׳ (read: כַּרְטֵיסָה or כַּרְטֵיסַיָּה pl.) irrespective of a previous document (or previous documents, against me) which may be in thy possession.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:9:2">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>אלא כי אורחא דבר נשא מימר אבד כַּרְטֵיסִי עבד חורן</he> but is it a usual matter for a man to say (to his debtor), my document has been lost, write another for me?—V. <cite ref="S02001"><he>קַרְטֵיס</he></cite>.
